# Julia Laing Studio

> A Scottish artist's online studio showcasing handmade original art, textile sculptures, jewelry, and accessories carefully crafted with sustainable practices.

Julia Laing Studio is an indie creative business based in Scotland offering original paintings, contemporary jewelry, textile-art soft sculptures, greeting cards, and giclee prints. All products are thoughtfully handmade with an emphasis on sustainability and artistic expression for creative people.

## Shop Collections

- [Collections Hub](https://julialaingstudio.com/collections): Main shop hub displaying all product categories and collections.
- [Original Art](https://julialaingstudio.com/collections/art): Original paintings and collage artworks by Julia Laing.
- [Giclee Prints](https://julialaingstudio.com/collections/art-prints): Professionally printed digital art prints for home decor.
- [Textile-Art Soft Sculptures](https://julialaingstudio.com/collections/textile-art-soft-sculptures): Eco-friendly textile soft sculptures with hand-embellished details.
- [Jewelry](https://julialaingstudio.com/collections/jewellery): Contemporary handmade jewellery collection crafted in Scotland.
- [Handmade Accessories](https://julialaingstudio.com/collections/handmade-accessories): Collection of handmade brooches, purses, and sustainable accessories.
- [Greeting Cards](https://julialaingstudio.com/collections/greeting-cards): UK-printed greeting cards from original artwork by Julia Laing.
- [Newest Products](https://julialaingstudio.com/collections/newest-products): Latest product arrivals including paintings and textile art.
